veranderings.voor: en sy kultuur in die rotskuns
veranderings.na: en vir sy kultuur in die rotskuns
veranderings.rede: Repeating 'vir' makes the two reasons for recognition clearly parallel, matching the glossary's 'vir sy natuur en ook vir sy kultuur'.

veranderings.voor: hul taal en tradisies en hul band
veranderings.na: hul taal, hul tradisies en hul band
veranderings.rede: Two 'en's inside one list make the grouping unclear; giving each item its own 'hul' separates them without a comma before 'en'.

veranderings.voor: Suid-Afrika met sy provinsies, en Lesotho
veranderings.na: Suid-Afrika met sy provinsies, asook Lesotho
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017 puts no comma before 'en' in a list; 'asook' keeps the separation from the provinces without breaking that rule.

veranderings.voor: die land en mense se kultuur
veranderings.na: die land en die kultuur van mense
veranderings.rede: 'die land en mense se kultuur' can be read as '(the land and people)'s culture'; this wording makes the two parts unambiguous.

vlae.teks: Die San is inheemse mense wat lank gelede ook in die berge geleef het.
vlae.rede: 'ook' has no antecedent: nothing earlier mentions another place the San lived, so a learner may wonder 'also' what. Removing it or naming the other places would change content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
